sections.heading: Architecture that Serves the Story
sections.body: We choose architecture that preserves vibe decisions: intent-first services, local caches for immediacy, and domain models that match user language. Modules align with scenes rather than technical layers when possible.

sections.heading: Bounded Contexts
sections.body: Each context maintains its vocabulary and contracts. Crossing contexts requires translation, not leakage. This prevents one feature’s complexity from eroding another’s simplicity.

sections.heading: Event-Driven Thinking
sections.body: Events represent beats: 'noteCreated', 'syncFailed', 'undoInvoked'. Event logs support observability and allow features to react without tight coupling. We keep event names narrative and stable.

sections.heading: Resilience Patterns
sections.body: Circuit breakers, retries with backoff, and idempotent operations are vibe enablers. They avoid jank and let UI stay responsive during turbulence. We prioritize these foundations early.

sections.heading: Exercises
sections.body: Model a scene with events and state transitions. Identify which components can work offline and define their cache behavior. Write an 'intent' API for one operation.
